my carbon monoxide alarm just went off i'm outside now
If a window is right there, open it. Then get everyone out of the house now and call 911 once you're outside.
okay i'm already outside um yeah there's no one else here it's just me i'll call nine one one right after this
Good, stay outside and call 911 from there. Do you want me to book a technician for after the problem has been shut off? Yes or no.
yeah yes okay can you just get someone out here it's 23 15 31st street astoria one one one oh two
Got it, 23-15 31st Street, Astoria, 11102. I need the name of the person booking, and I'll confirm the address. Sorry, I need your name for the booking. What's your name?
sofia marchetti
Thanks, Sofia. Is the unit or apartment number needed, or is it a house?
uh it's a house just the one address 23 15 31st street
Okay, a house. Let me read back the address and your number. Let me read that back: your home at 23-15 31st Street, Astoria, 11102, and the best number is 631, 555, 0165. Is that right?
yeah that's right um sorry i've got a headache my head's kind of foggy can you just give me the earliest one you've got

Sorry you're feeling foggy. Please get fresh air and call 911 now if it gets worse. Let me confirm the booking. The earliest opening is today, Monday, between 12 and 4. The technician will come after the gas or carbon monoxide problem has been shut off. Shall I book that window?
yes book that the earliest one twelve to four thanks

You're all set for today, Monday, with the technician arriving between 12 and 4. The technician can only work on it once the gas company or 911 has shut it off and said it's safe, so please stay outside until then. Anything else?
okay got it i'll call nine one one right after this thanks bye

transcript.text: Thanks for calling Summit Air, this is the virtual assistant. How can I help?
hey so i turned the heat on for the first time this year and you know it smelled like burning dust for a few minutes it's gone now but one room upstairs just stays cold
Just to confirm, it doesn't smell like sulfur or rotten eggs, right?
no nothing like that it was just dusty like when you first turn on a space heater you know smell's gone now
Just to be safe, are you smelling gas in the house right now?
no i don't smell anything right now nothing like gas no alarm going off either it was just that dusty smell for a few minutes when the heat first kicked on
Got it, a dusty smell that's cleared is common when heat first starts after a season off. Since the upstairs room stays cold, let's get someone out. Which ZIP code is the house in?
it's one one three seven two that's jackson heights the address is 35 20 82nd street
Good, you're in our service area. How cold is it in that upstairs room right now?
um about 63 degrees in there i checked it on the thermostat app this morning the rest of the house is warm it's just that one bedroom two of us live here we're both fine it's just annoying you know
Sixty-three in one room while the rest is warm, that's worth having a look. Is this a house you own, or are you renting?
i own the house i live here so i'm the one who'd approve any work go ahead and set it up
Okay, got it. What kind of system do you have, a furnace, a boiler, or something else? And roughly how old is it, if you know?

um i think it's a furnace forced air i'm pretty sure with ducts going up to the rooms i don't know exactly how old it is maybe fifteen ish years the house was already like that when i bought it so i'm not totally sure you know
That's fine, the technician can confirm the details when they're there. Have you tried anything yet, like adjusting the thermostat or checking the vents upstairs?
yeah i checked the upstairs vent and it's open air's coming out but it's pretty weak and i cranked the thermostat up but that didn't really change the room much the rest of the house is fine
Thanks, that helps the technician. Who's at home with it right now, and is anyone there who'd have a harder time with the cold?
it's just me and my wife at home right now and we're both healthy no one elderly or little kids or anything like that we're just cold upstairs that's all

Thanks, I'll note that. Let me check what's open for a heating visit. I've got openings today, between 12 and 4, or 4 to 8. Tomorrow and Wednesday have morning and afternoon too. Which works best for you?
hmm let's see today's kind of tight so i'd go with tomorrow morning if there's something is there a window for tomorrow morning
Yes, tomorrow morning, 8 to 12, is open. Shall I set that up?
yeah go ahead and book tomorrow morning 8 to 12
Before I book, I need to read back the address and phone number. Which number should the technician call, the one you're calling from?
yeah that's the one six three one five five five oh one six four and the address is 35 20 82nd street jackson heights one one three seven two sounds right you know
Let me read that back: your home at 35-20 82nd Street, Jackson Heights, 11372, and the best number is 631, 555, 0164. Is that right?
yep that's right thanks see you tomorrow morning
Can I get a name for the booking?
omar haddad
You're all set for tomorrow, Tuesday, with the technician arriving between 8 and 12. Anything else before I let you go?
no that's everything thanks a lot bye
Thanks for calling Summit Air. Stay warm out there.
